description: This file defines the UnmetDependenciesException class used in Drupal to handle exceptions related to unmet configuration dependencies, including methods for retrieving unmet dependencies, creating exception instances, and formatting dependency lists.

classes.name: UnmetDependenciesException
classes.description: An exception class for handling unmet configuration dependencies in Drupal, extending ConfigException, with methods to access unmet dependencies, create instances, and generate translated messages.

methods.name: getConfigObjects
methods.description: Returns the list of configuration objects with unmet dependencies.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Returns the name of the extension being installed.

methods.name: getTranslatedMessage
methods.description: Generates a translated message indicating unmet dependencies for an extension.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of UnmetDependenciesException with a list of unmet configuration objects for a specific extension.

methods.name: formatConfigObjectList
methods.description: Formats a list of configuration objects and their missing dependencies into a readable string.
